g.title: IndependentScraperEventGraph
g.text: V2: independent scrapers in a durable data-dependency graph

g.title: cluster_entry
g.text: 1. Direct calls return immediately; managed calls create an execution

g.title: cluster_planning
g.text: 2. Self-contained bundles plan typed initial inputs

g.title: cluster_graph
g.text: 3. Durable graph state: independent source branches and one mixed queue

g.title: cluster_execution
g.text: 4. TaskRunner invokes exactly one pinned scraper

g.title: cluster_commit
g.text: 5. Coordinator commits identity, immutable facts, continuations, and events atomically

g.title: cluster_policy
g.text: 6. Events drive fact dependencies, selection, and newly discovered work

g.title: cluster_completion
g.text: 7. Only final assembly is a global barrier

g.text: for example persist one vacancy detail

g.text: one independent branch per source/query group

g.text: listing x shared invocation x fact provider
